SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to), count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'cur_rows_per_member>1' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'members_without_current', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid_to_9999_not_current', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31' AND NOT is_current
UNION ALL SELECT 'current_but_valid_to_not_9999', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to<>DATE '9999-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid_today_rows_gold', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND valid_from<=DATE '2026-10-07' AND valid_to>=DATE '2026-10-07'
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_tier_values', count(DISTINCT tier) FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_member_key', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'future_join', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date>DATE '2026-10-07'
